meta.note: All entries below are fictional sample data for demonstration.

entries.name: Community Workshop 3D Printer
entries.description: Dual-extruder 3D printer available to members for prototyping. Includes a starter filament set and a monthly maintenance schedule.

entries.name: Neighborhood Tool Library Catalog
entries.description: Open-source inventory app used to track lending of hand tools, ladders, and garden equipment across three pickup sites.

entries.name: Volunteer Handbook v2
entries.description: Onboarding handbook covering safety procedures, code of conduct, and shift scheduling for new volunteers.

entries.name: East Side Meeting Room
entries.description: Seats 24 with projector and accessible entrance. Bookable by registered community groups in two-hour blocks.

entries.name: Laser Cutter (60W)
entries.description: Awaiting ventilation upgrade and safety sign-off before it can be opened to members.

entries.name: Legacy Member Database
entries.description: Retired spreadsheet-based member list, replaced by the new membership platform. Kept for historical reference only.

entries.name: Emergency Response Plan
entries.description: Evacuation routes, first-aid locations, and contact tree for all registered sites. Reviewed annually.

entries.name: Garden Shed & Greenhouse
entries.description: Shared growing space with seed library, rain barrels, and a locked tool shed. Plot assignments are pending review.

entries.name: Sewing Machine Set
entries.description: Six domestic sewing machines and two sergers used in weekly repair-cafe sessions.

entries.name: Old Event Signup Form
entries.description: Deprecated web form for event registration. Superseded by the shared booking calendar.
